diagnostic_protocol.range_definition: strict raw non-null validation < training min or > training max; equality is inside
diagnostic_protocol.range_fraction_denominator: non-null validation values; undefined training range yields NaN
diagnostic_protocol.zscore_definition: (validation filled with fixed training median - training scaler mean) / training scaler scale
diagnostic_protocol.coefficient_sign_policy: sign(0)=0; missing folds skipped; flips require opposite nonzero signs in consecutive available folds
diagnostic_protocol.svd_rank_tolerance: max(matrix.shape) * float64 eps * largest singular value
diagnostic_protocol.condition_number_policy: infinity if numerically rank deficient; JSON null plus condition_number_is_infinite flag
diagnostic_protocol.influence_design: post-scaling training X with intercept; SVD Moore-Penrose projection
diagnostic_protocol.influence_MSE: training residual SSE / (n - intercept-design numerical rank)
diagnostic_protocol.influence_undefined_policy: NaN with reason for zero residual variance, nonpositive residual df or unit leverage
diagnostic_protocol.state_comparison: current validation row versus its immediately previous observed session; no future state
diagnostic_protocol.state_age_semantics: existing calendar-day metadata; sample-effective age can be truncated at source window start
diagnostic_protocol.figures_feature_ordering: variability/magnitude ordering is visualization only; fitted features are unchanged

mechanism_assessment_policy: Combine errors, raw shift, z-scores, contributions, coefficient drift, conditioning and shrinkage descriptively; no automatic dominance or causality claim.
limitations: About one year of NVDA data; only the primary 5-session target is modeled.
Only 75 OOF observations, with 25 per fold under the registered protocol.
Overlapping 5-session targets and repeated fundamentals mean observations are not independent.
Results are a descriptive development-CV benchmark, not evidence of profitability or generalization.
No hyperparameter tuning, predictive feature selection or nonlinear models.
No final model fit, final-test prediction or final-test metric calculation.
No backtest, statistical significance test, transaction costs or portfolio construction.
Standardized-feature coefficients are diagnostics and cannot drive feature/model changes in this stage.
Linear diagnostics and state-transition associations are not causal evidence; coefficient drift and regime changes may be mixed.
